thread:
maya: Heads up — eu-west shared-gpu pool at 96% active kernels, tail latency climbing. Seeing steady queue growth from tenant: ai-summaries (tenant_id=t-42). ops-bot posted alert.

ops-bot: [ALERT] pool=eu-west-shared gpu_util=96% queue_len=312 tail_p99=1.8s

oliver: Can we confirm it's spillover (one noisy tenant), or global trend? Any kernel stall OOMs?

maya: Stacktrace shows many long-running decode jobs, kvcache misses spiking. prom query: `sum(rate(kv_cache.miss[1m])) by (tenant)` shows t-42 >> others.

jun: If it's noisy tenant, propose soft-spill policy: progressively route traffic to dedicated-burst pool instead of hard eviction. Need admission control to keep latency SLO for latency-sensitive tenants.

sara: Agreed. Pattern: detect sustained overutilization + high per-tenant miss ratio -> start "spill probe" that redirects 5% of requests for 30s to dedicated pool and measures tail-latency delta.

maya: Can we draft a config? e.g.,
```
policy: spill_probe
trigger: gpu_util > 90% for 60s
probe_fraction: 0.05
probe_window: 30s
criteria: tail_p99_reduction > 10% && error_rate_diff < 0.5%
action: route_probe -> dedicated-burst
fallback: enable_soft_throttle(tenant, rate_limit=0.8*baseline)
```

oliver: Add token-bucket local pacing to prevent probe amplification. Use leaky-bucket with warmup and decay: `bucket_rate = tenant_commit * 1.2`.

jun: Also prefer prefix-aware batching: don't mix long-decode streams with short-latency requests in same batch. Mark latency-sensitive routes with `latency_class: interactive`.

ash: How do we surface tenant decisions to customers? Need telemetry + billing signal. We should send an event: `tenant_spill_probe_started` with reason.

sara: Ops playbook note: if probe shows >15% error lift, auto-cancel and revert. If probe reduces tail by >10% and reduces tokens_used by >20%, escalate to architecture for dedicated-capacity offer.

maya: Quick rollout plan: enable detection in canary region for 48h, collect results, then enable auto-probe in eu-west.

ops-bot: [DEPLOY] policy/spill_probe v1 deployed to canary eu-west at 2042003300 by taylor

oliver: I'll add metrics dashboards: `tenant_spill_probe.success_rate`, `probe_tail_p99_delta`, `spill_routed_qps`.

jun: One more—networking note: routing to dedicated-burst relies on cross-host bandwidth; confirm uplink headroom to dedicated nodes to avoid creating another bottleneck.

maya: good call — ops to validate NIC saturation post-probe.

ash: ping @customers-team so they can prep messaging for tenants if we start automated routing.

sara: fine. if nobody objects I'll start a short RFC for config and add tests (integration + chaos tests simulating KV thrash). :+1:

oliver: no objections here.

maya: thanks all. will follow up with probe dashboard link later.
